answer: The raven cap is policed at intake and meadow shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a garden tag. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
